mapper.select: /* selectMasterMpStQuotExceptionList */ SELECT (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = X.KEP_DEPT) AS TEAM_NM , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M106' AND CODE = X.BID_SUCCESS_CODE ) AS GUBUN , COUNT(*) AS RE_CNT , SUM(ITEM_QTY) AS TOT_QTY , TRUNC(SUM(ITEM_QTY * LOW_PRICE),0) AS LOW_AMT , TRUNC(SUM(ITEM_QTY * BUY_PRICE),0) AS BUY_AMT , TRUNC(SUM(ITEM_QTY * BUY_PRICE - ITEM_QTY * LOW_PRICE),0) AS DIF_AMT , TRUNC(SUM(X.ITEM_QTY*BUY_PRICE)/ SUM(X.ITEM_QTY*LOW_PRICE) *100 - 100,1) AS AMT_RATE FROM KEP_RE_PRICE_VERITY X WHERE X.YYYYMM BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} AND X.KEP_DEPT = DECODE(#{st_dept},'',X.KEP_DEPT,#{st_dept}) GROUP BY X.KEP_DEPT, X.BID_SUCCESS_CODE ORDER BY TEAM_NM,GUBUN

/* selectMasterMpStPoPriceAdjustList */ SELECT (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKORE0001' AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = KEP_DEPT) AS TEAM_NAME , DECODE(UP_DOWN_FLAG,'U','인상','인하') AS UP_DOWN , COUNT(*) AS PO_CNT , SUM(ITEM_QTY) AS TOT_QTY , TRUNC(SUM(ITEM_QTY * BEFOR_AGENT_PRICE ),0) AS BEFOR_AMT , TRUNC(SUM(ITEM_QTY * CURRENT_AGENT_PRICE),0) AS CURRENT_AMT , TRUNC(SUM(ITEM_QTY * CURRENT_AGENT_PRICE - ITEM_QTY * BEFOR_AGENT_PRICE),0) AS DIF_AMT , TRUNC(TRUNC(SUM(ITEM_QTY * CURRENT_AGENT_PRICE),0) / TRUNC(SUM(ITEM_QTY * BEFOR_AGENT_PRICE),0) *100 -100,1) AS AMT_RATE FROM KEP_PO_PRICE_VERITY X WHERE X.YYYYMM BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} AND X.KEP_DEPT = DECODE(#{st_dept},'',X.KEP_DEPT,#{st_dept}) GROUP BY KEP_DEPT, UP_DOWN_FLAG ORDER BY TEAM_NAME,UP_DOWN
